```{r setup, include=FALSE}

opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, cache = FALSE, prompt = FALSE,
               tidy = TRUE, comment = NA, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
               fig.path = "output/figures/", dev = "png", dpi = 150)
opts_knit$set(width = 75)
```

# Purpose

Catchments, point-pattern analysis, spatial autocorrelation, a MAUP check, and
the interactive Leaflet product. Reads only from `data/processed/` — no internet
or API token needed. Take that folder from the GitHub Release and this script
runs offline.

Expensive steps (network build, network distances) are cached to disk and skipped
on reruns.

```{r libraries}
library(pacman)
p_load(sf, tidyverse, here, units, sfnetworks, tidygraph,
       spatstat, spdep, tmap, mapview, leaflet, htmltools, htmlwidgets,
       ggrepel, scales)

crs_dk <- 25832
fs::dir_create(here("output/figures")); fs::dir_create(here("output/maps"))
fig_dir <- here("output/figures")   # explicit saves go here (robust across tmap/ggplot/base)

cache_rds <- function(path, compute) {
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  obj <- compute(); saveRDS(obj, path); obj
}
```

# 0. Load inputs

```{r load}
aarhus_mun     <- readRDS(here("data/processed/aarhus_mun.rds"))
districts      <- readRDS(here("data/processed/districts.rds"))
kontur_aarhus  <- readRDS(here("data/processed/kontur_aarhus.rds"))
pois           <- readRDS(here("data/processed/pois.rds"))
parks_polygons <- readRDS(here("data/processed/parks_polygons.rds"))
walk_network   <- sfarrow::st_read_parquet(here("data/processed/aarhus_walk_network.parquet"))

nonpark_categories <- setdiff(unique(pois$category), "park")

# All inputs must be EPSG:25832
stopifnot(all(c(st_crs(aarhus_mun)$epsg, st_crs(kontur_aarhus)$epsg,
                st_crs(pois)$epsg, st_crs(walk_network)$epsg) == crs_dk))
```

For non-park categories distance is to the POI point; for parks it is the
shortest distance to the park boundary, with hexes whose centroid lies inside a
park set to 0.

# 1. Routable walking network

Largest connected component only, so orphaned fragments don't create infinite
distances.

```{r build-network}
network_main <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/network_main.rds"), function() {
  walk_lines <- walk_network %>%
    st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>% st_cast("LINESTRING") %>%
    st_make_valid() %>% filter(!st_is_empty(geometry))

  net <- as_sfnetwork(walk_lines, directed = FALSE) %>%
    convert(to_spatial_subdivision, .clean = TRUE) %>%
    convert(to_spatial_smooth,      .clean = TRUE) %>%
    activate("edges") %>% mutate(weight = edge_length())

  comps   <- net %>% activate("nodes") %>% mutate(comp = group_components()) %>%
    as_tibble() %>% pull(comp)
  biggest <- as.integer(names(which.max(table(comps))))
  net %>% activate("nodes") %>% filter(group_components() == biggest)
})

nodes_main <- network_main %>% activate("nodes") %>% st_as_sf()
cat("Network nodes (largest component):", nrow(nodes_main), "\n")
```

```{r snap-diagnostic}
# How far are non-park POIs from the nearest network node?
pois_nonpark <- pois %>% filter(category != "park")
snap_dist <- as.numeric(st_distance(
  pois_nonpark, nodes_main[st_nearest_feature(pois_nonpark, nodes_main), ],
  by_element = TRUE))

tibble(category = pois_nonpark$category, snap_m = snap_dist) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(median_snap = round(median(snap_m), 1),
            n_far_off   = sum(snap_m > 100), .groups = "drop")
```

# 2. Euclidean catchments (baseline)

One unioned polygon per (category, distance). Non-park: buffer the points;
park: buffer the polygons.

```{r euclidean-catchments}
distances_m <- c(400, 800)

catchments_eucl <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/catchments_eucl.rds"), function() {
  eucl_point <- function(cat, d) {
    pois %>% filter(category == cat) %>% st_buffer(d) %>% st_union() %>%
      st_intersection(aarhus_mun) %>%
      st_sf(category = cat, distance_m = d, method = "euclidean", geometry = .)
  }
  eucl_park <- function(d) {
    parks_polygons %>% st_buffer(d) %>% st_union() %>%
      st_intersection(aarhus_mun) %>%
      st_sf(category = "park", distance_m = d, method = "euclidean", geometry = .)
  }
  nonpark <- tidyr::crossing(category = nonpark_categories, distance_m = distances_m) %>%
    pmap_dfr(function(category, distance_m) eucl_point(category, distance_m))
  park <- map_dfr(distances_m, eucl_park)
  bind_rows(nonpark, park)
})

mapview(filter(catchments_eucl, distance_m == 800), zcol = "category",
        alpha.regions = 0.3, layer.name = "800 m Euclidean catchments")
```

# 3. Network distances and coverage flags

Hex centroids are the demand points (a 400 m hex holds people up to ~230 m from
its centroid — noted as a resolution limit).

```{r hex-centroids}
# hex_id = row order of kontur_aarhus; every downstream join reuses this order,
# so kontur_aarhus must not be re-sorted.
hex_pts <- kontur_aarhus %>% st_centroid() %>%
  mutate(hex_id = row_number()) %>%
  select(hex_id, h3, population, distrikt)
```

## 3a. Non-park categories — distance to the nearest POI point

```{r network-distances-nonpark}
nearest_nonpark <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_nearest_poi_nonpark.rds"), function() {
  nearest_dist <- function(cat) {
    pois_cat <- pois %>% filter(category == cat)
    cost <- st_network_cost(network_main, from = hex_pts, to = pois_cat,
                            weights = "weight") %>% drop_units()
    min_d <- apply(cost, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    min_d[is.infinite(min_d)] <- NA_real_
    tibble(hex_id = hex_pts$hex_id, category = cat, dist_m = min_d)
  }
  map_dfr(nonpark_categories, nearest_dist)
})
```

## 3b. Parks — distance to the boundary, not a centre point

A park is an area, entered from its edge, so measuring distance to a single
centre point would overstate how far people are from large parks. Instead each
park boundary is sampled every ~30 m, the distance is the shortest network path
to any of those edge points, and hexes whose centroid already sits inside a park
are set to 0. The Euclidean catchments (§2) follow the same logic by buffering
the polygons rather than points.

```{r network-distances-park}
nearest_park <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_nearest_poi_park.rds"), function() {
  access_pts <- parks_polygons %>%
    mutate(park_id_src = row_number()) %>%
    st_boundary() %>% st_cast("LINESTRING", warn = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(park_id_src) %>% summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
    st_line_sample(density = 1/30) %>% st_cast("POINT") %>% st_sf()

  cost_park <- st_network_cost(network_main, from = hex_pts, to = access_pts,
                               weights = "weight") %>% drop_units()
  min_park <- apply(cost_park, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_park[is.infinite(min_park)] <- NA_real_
  min_park[lengths(st_intersects(hex_pts, parks_polygons)) > 0] <- 0

  tibble(hex_id = hex_pts$hex_id, category = "park", dist_m = min_park)
})

# Park-distance sanity: how reachable are parks?
park_d <- nearest_park$dist_m
cat("Hexes within 400 m of a park edge:", round(100 * mean(park_d < 400, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("Hexes within 800 m of a park edge:", round(100 * mean(park_d < 800, na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
hist(park_d[park_d > 0 & park_d < 2000], breaks = 50,
     main = "Distance to nearest park edge (excl. inside-park hexes)", xlab = "metres")
```

## 3c. Combine

```{r combine-distances}
nearest_long <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_nearest_poi.rds"), function() {
  bind_rows(nearest_nonpark, nearest_park)
})
```

```{r coverage-flags}
hex_coverage <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_coverage.rds"), function() {
  nearest_wide <- nearest_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = dist_m, names_prefix = "dist_")

  coverage <- nearest_wide %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("dist_"),
                  list(`400` = ~ .x < 400, `800` = ~ .x < 800),
                  .names = "cov{.col}_{.fn}m")) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "dist_", ""), .cols = starts_with("covdist_"))

  kontur_aarhus %>% mutate(hex_id = row_number()) %>%
    left_join(coverage, by = "hex_id")
})
```

# 4. Headline coverage (% population within reach)

```{r coverage-table}
total_pop <- sum(hex_coverage$population, na.rm = TRUE)

coverage_summary <- hex_coverage %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("cov"),
                   ~ sum(population[.x], na.rm = TRUE) / total_pop * 100)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "metric", values_to = "pct_pop_covered") %>%
  mutate(category   = str_extract(metric, "(?<=cov)[a-z_]+(?=_)"),
         distance_m = as.integer(str_extract(metric, "\\d+(?=m)")),
         pct_pop_covered = round(pct_pop_covered, 1)) %>%
  select(category, distance_m, pct_pop_covered) %>%
  arrange(category, distance_m)

coverage_summary
```

```{r eucl-vs-network}
hex_pts_pop <- kontur_aarhus %>% st_centroid() %>%
  mutate(hex_id = row_number()) %>% select(hex_id, population)

eucl_cov <- catchments_eucl %>% group_split(category, distance_m) %>%
  map_dfr(function(s) {
    inside <- st_intersects(hex_pts_pop, s, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
    tibble(category = s$category, distance_m = s$distance_m,
           pct_pop_covered_eucl =
             round(100 * sum(hex_pts_pop$population[inside], na.rm = TRUE) / total_pop, 1))
  })

comparison <- coverage_summary %>%
  rename(pct_pop_covered_network = pct_pop_covered) %>%
  left_join(eucl_cov, by = c("category", "distance_m")) %>%
  mutate(diff_pp = pct_pop_covered_eucl - pct_pop_covered_network)

comparison
```

# 5. Hex analysis variables

Composite count = number of categories reachable within 800 m network walk (0–5).

```{r hex-vars}
composite <- nearest_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = dist_m, names_prefix = "dist_") %>%
  mutate(composite_count = rowSums(across(starts_with("dist_"), ~ .x < 800), na.rm = TRUE))

hex_analysis <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_analysis.rds"), function() {
  base <- hex_coverage %>% mutate(hex_id = row_number()) %>%
    select(hex_id, h3, population, distrikt, starts_with("cov")) %>%
    left_join(composite, by = "hex_id")

  # Euclidean coverage flags (centroid-in-catchment) so the map can toggle method
  hex_centroids <- base %>% st_centroid() %>% select(hex_id)
  eucl_flags <- catchments_eucl %>%
    mutate(grp = paste0("cov_", category, "_", distance_m, "_eucl")) %>%
    group_split(grp) %>%
    map_dfr(function(s) tibble(hex_id = hex_centroids$hex_id, grp = s$grp[1],
                               value = lengths(st_intersects(hex_centroids, s)) > 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = grp, values_from = value)

  base %>% left_join(eucl_flags, by = "hex_id") %>%
    rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "^cov([a-z_]+)_(\\d+)m$", "cov_\\1_\\2_net"),
                .cols = matches("^cov[a-z_]+_\\d+m$"))
})

hex_analysis %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(composite_count) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
```

# 6. Point pattern analysis — do third places cluster more than people?

```{r ppa-setup}
win <- as.owin(aarhus_mun)
categories <- unique(pois$category)

build_ppp <- function(cat_name) {
  xy <- pois %>% filter(category == cat_name) %>% st_coordinates()
  ppp(xy[, "X"], xy[, "Y"], window = win, check = FALSE)
}
ppp_list <- setNames(lapply(categories, build_ppp), categories)
sapply(ppp_list, npoints)
```

```{r pop-surface, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# Population intensity surface (people/m^2), sigma = hex apothem
kontur_pp <- kontur_aarhus %>% st_centroid() %>%
  { ppp(st_coordinates(.)[, "X"], st_coordinates(.)[, "Y"],
        window = win, marks = .$population, check = FALSE) }
pop_im <- density(kontur_pp, weights = marks(kontur_pp), sigma = 400, edge = TRUE)

plot(pop_im, main = "Population intensity (people / m^2, sigma = 400 m)")
plot(aarhus_mun$geometry, add = TRUE, border = "white", lwd = 0.5)
```

A Poisson model `ppm(pp ~ pop_im)` fits log-intensity against population
density; a positive coefficient means the category is preferentially located
where people live.

```{r ppm}
pop_vals <- as.numeric(pop_im$v); pop_vals <- pop_vals[is.finite(pop_vals)]
pop_z    <- (pop_im - mean(pop_vals)) / sd(pop_vals)

ppm_results <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/ppm_results.rds"), function() {
  res <- list()
  for (cat_name in categories) {
    pp <- ppp_list[[cat_name]]
    if (npoints(pp) >= 10) res[[cat_name]] <- ppm(pp ~ pop_z)
  }
  res
})

ppm_summary <- map_dfr(names(ppm_results), function(cat_name) {
  co <- summary(ppm_results[[cat_name]])$coefs.SE.CI
  z  <- co["pop_z", "Zval"]
  tibble(category           = cat_name,
         coef_pop_sd        = round(co["pop_z", "Estimate"], 3),
         rate_ratio_per_sd  = round(exp(co["pop_z", "Estimate"]), 2),
         z                  = round(z, 2),
         p_value            = signif(2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z))), 3))
})
saveRDS(ppm_summary, here("data/processed/ppm_summary.rds"))
ppm_summary
```

```{r ppm-residuals, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Negative (blue) = fewer POIs than population predicts -> relative under-supply
png(file.path(fig_dir, "ppm_residuals.png"), width = 12, height = 8,
    units = "in", res = 200)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (cat_name in names(ppm_results)) {
  plot(Smooth(residuals(ppm_results[[cat_name]], type = "raw"), sigma = 500),
       main = paste0("PPM residuals: ", cat_name))
  plot(aarhus_mun$geometry, add = TRUE, border = "white", lwd = 0.4)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1)); dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(fig_dir, "ppm_residuals.png"))
```

# 7. Spatial autocorrelation

```{r hex-weights}
hex_w <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_weights.rds"), function() {
  nb <- poly2nb(hex_analysis, queen = TRUE)
  list(nb = nb, lw = nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE))
})
lw_hex <- hex_w$lw
cat("Hexes with zero neighbours:", sum(card(hex_w$nb) == 0), "\n")
```

```{r global-moran}
moran_vars <- c("cov_park_800_net", "cov_library_800_net", "cov_cafe_800_net",
                "cov_fitness_centre_800_net", "cov_community_centre_800_net",
                "composite_count")

global_moran <- map_dfr(moran_vars, function(v) {
  vec <- as.numeric(hex_analysis[[v]]); vec[is.na(vec)] <- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  mc <- moran.mc(vec, lw_hex, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
  tibble(variable = v, morans_I = round(as.numeric(mc$statistic), 3),
         p_MC = signif(mc$p.value, 3))
})
global_moran
```

At ~6,000 units adjacency alone makes almost any variable significant, so the
*magnitude* and the LISA maps below carry the finding, not the p-value.

```{r lisa}
# Variables are coverage flags / counts (high = well served), so no sign flip
# is needed: HH = covered-among-covered (well-served core); LL = gap-among-gaps
# (underserved cluster). FDR-corrected permutation LISA (Anselin 1995).
classify_lisa <- function(x, lw, alpha = 0.05) {
  x[is.na(x)] <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  lm_res <- localmoran_perm(x, lw, nsim = 999, zero.policy = TRUE)
  p_fdr <- p.adjust(lm_res[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"], method = "fdr")
  z     <- as.numeric(scale(x))
  lag_z <- as.numeric(scale(lag.listw(lw, x, zero.policy = TRUE)))
  cluster <- case_when(
    p_fdr >= alpha      ~ "Not significant",
    z >= 0 & lag_z >= 0 ~ "High-High",
    z <  0 & lag_z <  0 ~ "Low-Low",
    z >= 0 & lag_z <  0 ~ "High-Low",
    z <  0 & lag_z >= 0 ~ "Low-High",
    TRUE                ~ "Not significant")
  factor(cluster, levels = c("High-High", "Low-Low", "High-Low",
                             "Low-High", "Not significant"))
}

hex_lisa <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/hex_lisa.rds"), function() {
  out <- hex_analysis
  for (v in moran_vars)
    out[[paste0("lisa_", v)]] <- classify_lisa(as.numeric(hex_analysis[[v]]), lw_hex)
  out
})
```

```{r lisa-facet, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
tmap_mode("plot")
lisa_palette <- c("High-High" = "#d7191c", "Low-Low" = "#2c7bb6",
                  "High-Low" = "#fdae61", "Low-High" = "#abd9e9",
                  "Not significant" = "ivory2")
facet_vars   <- paste0("lisa_", moran_vars)
facet_labels <- c("Parks", "Libraries", "Cafés", "Fitness centres",
                  "Community centres", "Composite (categories ≤ 800 m)")

lisa_maps <- lapply(seq_along(facet_vars), function(i) {
  tm_shape(hex_lisa) +
    tm_polygons(facet_vars[i], palette = lisa_palette, border.col = NA,
                showNA = FALSE, title = "LISA cluster") +
    tm_shape(aarhus_mun) + tm_borders(col = "grey30", lwd = 0.7) +
    tm_layout(main.title = facet_labels[i], main.title.size = 1.0,
              legend.show = (i == length(facet_vars)), frame = FALSE)
})
lisa_facet <- do.call(tmap_arrange, c(lisa_maps, list(ncol = 3)))
tmap_save(lisa_facet, file.path(fig_dir, "lisa_facet.png"),
          width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 200)
lisa_facet
```


# 8. Interactive coverage explorer (Leaflet product)

```{r leaflet-prep}
hex_wgs    <- st_transform(hex_analysis, 4326)
parks_wgs  <- st_transform(parks_polygons, 4326)
pois_wgs   <- st_transform(pois, 4326)
aarhus_wgs <- st_transform(aarhus_mun, 4326)

cat_colors <- c(park = "#1a9850", library = "#984ea3", cafe = "#ff7f00",
                fitness_centre = "#e41a1c", community_centre = "#377eb8")
cat_labels <- c(park = "Parks", library = "Libraries", cafe = "Cafés",
                fitness_centre = "Fitness centres", community_centre = "Community centres")

# Composite count (network) at each distance
hex_wgs <- hex_wgs %>%
  mutate(n_400_net = rowSums(across(ends_with("_400_net")), na.rm = TRUE),
         n_800_net = rowSums(across(ends_with("_800_net")), na.rm = TRUE))

pal_count <- colorNumeric("YlGnBu", domain = 0:5, na.color = "#00000000")
```

```{r leaflet-map}
# Native Leaflet allows only one radio dimension, so distance is encoded in each
# layer's name. Tick a category to see the hexes it covers at that distance.
map <- leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 10, preferCanvas = TRUE)) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
  addPolygons(data = aarhus_wgs, fill = FALSE, color = "#222", weight = 1.5,
              group = "Aarhus boundary")

cov_groups <- character(0)

# Composite count (toggleable), one layer per distance
for (d in c(400, 800)) {
  g <- paste0("Categories covered ≤", d, " m"); col <- paste0("n_", d, "_net")
  map <- map %>% addPolygons(
    data = hex_wgs, group = g, fillColor = pal_count(hex_wgs[[col]]),
    fillOpacity = 0.7, stroke = FALSE,
    label = paste0(hex_wgs[[col]], " of 5 categories ≤", d, " m"))
  cov_groups <- c(cov_groups, g)
}

# Per-category covered hexes, one layer per (category, distance)
for (d in c(400, 800)) for (cat in names(cat_labels)) {
  col <- paste0("cov_", cat, "_", d, "_net")
  covered <- hex_wgs[which(hex_wgs[[col]]), ]
  if (nrow(covered) == 0) next
  g <- paste0(cat_labels[[cat]], " ≤", d, " m")
  map <- map %>% addPolygons(
    data = covered, group = g, fillColor = cat_colors[[cat]],
    fillOpacity = if (d == 400) 0.55 else 0.35, stroke = FALSE,
    smoothFactor = 0.3, label = g)
  cov_groups <- c(cov_groups, g)
}

map <- map %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = pois_wgs, group = "Third places (points)",
    color = cat_colors[pois_wgs$category], radius = 3, stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.85, label = ~name) %>%
  addPolygons(data = parks_wgs, group = "Park polygons",
    fillColor = "#1a9850", fillOpacity = 0.25, color = "#1a9850", weight = 0.8) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c(cov_groups, "Third places (points)",
                      "Park polygons", "Aarhus boundary"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE)) %>%
  hideGroup(setdiff(c(cov_groups, "Third places (points)", "Park polygons"),
                    "Categories covered ≤800 m")) %>%
  addLegend(pal = pal_count, values = 0:5, opacity = 0.7,
            title = "Categories covered (0–5)", position = "bottomright")

saveWidget(map, here("output/maps/coverage_map.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)
map
```

# 9. MAUP robustness — repeat at lokalsamfund scale

If the underserved/well-served structure survives the unit change it is
MAUP-robust (Openshaw 1984). At ~28 districts, expect weaker statistics.

```{r district-analysis}
agg_vars <- c("cov_park_800_net", "cov_library_800_net", "cov_cafe_800_net",
              "cov_fitness_centre_800_net", "cov_community_centre_800_net",
              "composite_count")

district_an <- cache_rds(here("data/processed/district_lisa.rds"), function() {
  dv <- hex_analysis %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% filter(!is.na(distrikt)) %>%
    group_by(distrikt) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(agg_vars),
                     ~ weighted.mean(as.numeric(.x), w = population, na.rm = TRUE)),
              pop_total = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  d <- districts %>% left_join(dv, by = "distrikt") %>%
    mutate(area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)) / 1e6,
           pop_density = pop_total / area_km2)

  lw_d <- nb2listw(poly2nb(d, queen = TRUE), style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  d %>% mutate(
    lisa_cov_park_800_net = classify_lisa(cov_park_800_net, lw_d),
    lisa_composite_count  = classify_lisa(composite_count, lw_d))
})

cat("Districts retained:", nrow(district_an), "\n")
```

```{r maup-map, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
m_hex <- tm_shape(hex_lisa) +
  tm_polygons("lisa_composite_count", palette = lisa_palette, border.col = NA,
              showNA = FALSE, title = "Cluster") +
  tm_shape(districts) + tm_borders(col = "grey40", lwd = 0.4) +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Hex scale", legend.outside = TRUE, frame = FALSE)
m_dist <- tm_shape(district_an) +
  tm_polygons("lisa_composite_count", palette = lisa_palette,
              border.col = "grey20", lwd = 0.4, showNA = FALSE, title = "Cluster") +
  tm_layout(main.title = "Lokalsamfund scale", legend.outside = TRUE, frame = FALSE)
maup_compare <- tmap_arrange(m_hex, m_dist, ncol = 2)
tmap_save(maup_compare, file.path(fig_dir, "maup_compare.png"),
          width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 200)
maup_compare
```

```{r pop-density-scatter, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
scatter_plot <- district_an %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  ggplot(aes(pop_density, composite_count, label = distrikt)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = pop_total), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, max.overlaps = 15) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Population density (people / km², log)",
       y = "Mean count of third-place categories ≤ 800 m",
       size = "Population", title = "Are denser districts better served?") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "pop_density_scatter.png"), scatter_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 200)
scatter_plot
```

# Outputs

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `network_main.rds` | sfnetwork, largest component, metre edge weights |
| `catchments_eucl.rds` | 10 Euclidean catchment polygons |
| `hex_nearest_poi_nonpark.rds` | hex × non-park category → distance to nearest POI point (m) |
| `hex_nearest_poi_park.rds` | hex → distance to nearest park *edge* (m); inside-park = 0 |
| `hex_nearest_poi.rds` | the two combined |
| `hex_coverage.rds` | hexes + network coverage flags |
| `hex_analysis.rds` | hexes + composite + network & Euclidean flags |
| `hex_lisa.rds`, `district_lisa.rds` | LISA clusters at both scales |
| `ppm_summary.rds` | PPM coefficients per category |
| `output/maps/coverage_map.html` | interactive Leaflet product |
